title: Summarize authoritative source freshness across the fully authorized Command Work Queue view
goal: Provide one Class-0 whole-view freshness inventory of authorized, filtered Incident/Task rows across pages, reusing CAP-CMD-109A owner source policy and CAP-CMD-101's existing single route and permission projection.
invariants: Only rows AFTER per-Item Owner.CanRead AND canonical view/status filter contribute; foreign/denied/filtered-out items never affect counts.
Aggregate all authorized matching rows across paginated view, not just the displayed 50; a revoked/stale cursor returns no counts or rows.
Host-owned source policy and observed_at determine current/aging/stale, never Command UpdatedAt nor invented thresholds.
No freshness metadata anywhere in the cohort => omit new view_freshness JSON, preserving legacy clients. Missing metadata among otherwise supplied values => unknown, not current.
No extra source/provider reads, mutation, Shared policy duplication, new route, IAM model or external libraries.
security_properties: All source data authorized by existing Project owner CanRead before aggregation; no new metadata of hidden source providers.
Changed authorization or stale cursor is checked before publishing aggregate; no partial counts/rows on permission errors.
Native existing html/template, CSP and no-store; only non-sensitive authorized aggregate integers added.
inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-109 full §§1–27 and CAP-CMD-101 full §§1–27, Command module, Incident/Task owners, and existing CAP-CMD-109A source freshness engine.
Frozen parent #168 HEAD 40ee320eeaac44847f9a5c088f91ff451030a21e on #167, exact-head Command Go/Linux/macOS/Windows and engineering kernel both SUCCESS.
Existing Command source metadata only; no new owner-policy threshold decision.
outputs: Read-only filtered and scoped view_freshness summary with total/current/aging/stale/partial/source_unavailable/unknown for entire authorized cursor cohort, omitted if no authoritative source metadata.
Same summary in existing native single-route Command Work Queue HTML, without a new page or provider.
Go integration tests for exact scopes, cross-page stable aggregate, cursor revocation, filtered-out denied sources, partial/unknown and legacy JSON.
acceptance_tests: Different authorized Incident/Task source ages and unavailable metadata yield exact full-view counts without inventing a threshold.
A page 2 view reports the same authorized full-view summary as page 1 until a current owner revocation invalidates its cursor.
A source outage of a denied, other-tenant or filtered-out item changes no visible summary or diagnostic; corrupted metadata fails closed.
Owner with no source freshness preserves JSON field set; HTML renders authorized counts without new endpoint.
definition_of_ready: Existing CAP-CMD-109A-FRESHNESS task IMPLEMENTED in graph, single Go owner freshness projector reusable; CAP-CMD-101G-PAGE task IMPLEMENTED and revocation-safe authorized paging integrated.
Canonical Class-0 freshness view projection does not depend on OPEN-013 mutations or definitive new tenant thresholds.
Frozen Git parent PR #168 40ee320eeaac44847f9a5c088f91ff451030a21e has exact-head Command runtime and engineering-kernel success, though ancestors remain unmerged.
definition_of_done: Actual authorized whole-view freshness summary visible on existing Work Queue route and independently tested in exact-head GitHub CI.
Mark only E10-CMD-109B-VIEW IMPLEMENTED, not CAP-CMD-109 ACCEPTED or production delivered; L2 on stable material integration in read-only independent context.
No claim that ancestor PRs have native approvals/merged, or that product SLA/refresh jobs are implemented.

migration.rationale: JSON opt-in field omitted when no authoritative freshness; existing single HTTP route and item source data unchanged.

rollback.strategy: Remove optional ViewFreshness summary and native HTML status while retaining CAP-CMD-109A per-item freshness and queue paging.
verification: Existing JSON/HTML and six system views with no provider metadata remain unchanged.

performance_budget.rationale: One O(n) pass over <=5000 already authorized filtered candidates; zero extra owner calls and no new network/provider loads.
metrics: <=5000 bounded matched candidates, existing 50 rows/page unchanged.
Same total counts across reauthorized cursor pages; one pass over already materialized authorized candidates.
